method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 把车停在县道边，看见 Eeling 的租用车还停在小平房前，明白他并未离开。
facts.anchor: The low outline of Eeling’s rental car is there in front of the small house when she pulls to a stop on the side of the county road.

facts.fact: 她低声骂了一句脏话，把车拐进车道，决定试探他、让他明白 Julian 一家不可碰。
facts.anchor: “Fuck,” she whispers, and turns into the drive.

facts.fact: 她盘算自己唯一的底牌：若 Eeling 不接受条件，就取消采访、揭发他的敲诈。
facts.anchor: If he won’t agree to her terms, she’ll scrap the interview. Expose his blackmail.

facts.fact: 她按门铃无回应后，决定改试门把手，发现门没锁。
facts.anchor: She hits the doorbell, but no sound comes from inside—at least that she can hear. She considers driving home and coming back in the morning, then tries the knob instead.

facts.fact: 她进屋后听到房子深处有隐约的乐声。
facts.anchor: An indistinct tinkle somewhere deeper in the house.

facts.fact: 她打开几盏灯，在厨房与餐厅交界处看到餐桌上 Eeling 合上的笔记本电脑。
facts.anchor: Eeling’s closed laptop sits on the dining table among a few other items.

facts.fact: 她沿走廊上二楼，认出那乐声是长笛演奏。
facts.anchor: At first the tinkling of what she now recognizes as flute was soothing.

facts.fact: 她进卧室开灯，看见被下躺着一个人形，一只苍白的手臂伸出床沿。
facts.anchor: A manshape lies beneath the covers and one pale arm stretches out over the far side of the bed, palm up.

facts.fact: 她掀开被子，看到 Eeling 头上套着凝结水汽的塑料袋，喉咙被黑色扎带勒紧封死。
facts.anchor: And the thick plastic bag over his head clouded with condensation of his last breaths, a wide black zip tie cinched around his throat, sealing the bag shut.
